AFRICA_DAY: (Ukubhiyozela uSuku lwe-25 lwe-Afrika, Le App yoQeqesho lwaMaphayona ePi yasungulwa)
INTRO_P1: Pi Network yiprojekthi yemali yedijithali kunye ne-ecosystem yehlabathi eyilelwe ukwenza i-cryptocurrency ifikeleleke kwaye iluncedo kumntu wonke.
INTRO_P2: Ngokungafaniyo nee-cryptocurrencies zesintu ezihlala zifuna oomatshini bokwemba ababizayo kunye nombane omninzi, iPi Network ivumela abantu abaqhelekileyo ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngokuthe ngqo kwiifowuni zabo.
INTRO_P3: Umbono we-Pi Network kukwakha i-ecosystem eqhutywa ngabantu apho imali yedijithali inokusetyenziselwa ukusetyenziswa okwenyani, iinkonzo zokwenyani, uluntu lokwenyani kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kwezoqoqosho lokwenyani.
M1: Ukwakha uqoqosho lwedijithali olubandakanya wonke umntu
CH1_SUB: Wamkelekile kwiZiko Lemfundo yaMaphayona aseAfrika - Ngaphandle. Eli qonga lenzelwe ukufundisa, ukuxhobisa kunye nokulungiselela amaphayona aseAfrika kunye namashishini ukuba athathe inxaxheba ngokufanelekileyo kwi-Pi Ecosystem.
DAILY_MINING: Imigodi Yemihla Ngemihla: Buya rhoqo kwiiyure ezingama-24 ukuze uqhubeke nokwemba.
WALLET_SEC: Ukhuseleko lweWallet: Ungaze wabelane ngamagama akho angama-24 ePassphrase. Nabani na onamagama la ngumnini wewallet.
CH2_DESC: Funda indlela yokufumana kunye nokuthumela iPi ngokukhuselekileyo usebenzisa iPi Wallet kwiPi Browser.
CH2A_DESC: Qala ngemali encinci yovavanyo, qinisekisa idilesi, unganikeli ngepassphrase yakho.
CH3_DESC: I-Pi Browser DApps zizicelo ezinatyisiweyo zokusetyenziswa okwenyani.
CH4_DESC: Fumana amashishini amkela iPi kwihlabathi jikelele.
CH5_DESC: Ixabiso leMvumelwano yeHlabathi (GCV) likhuthaza ukusetyenziswa okwenyani kwi-ecosystem.
CH6_DESC: Funda incwadi yesikhokelo kaDoris Yin yokudala ukusetyenziswa kunye nokukhula kwe-ecosystem.
MERCHANT_DESC: Indlela yokujoyina i-ecosystem, ukudwelisa ishishini lakho kwiMapOfPi, ukwamkela intlawulo yePi.
FINAL_P: IAfrika inethuba lokuba yenye yemimandla eyomeleleyo ekusetyenzisweni okusebenzayo ngaphakathi kwiPi Ecosystem. Sikha kunye. Sifundisa kunye. Sixhobisa iAfrika kunye ngePi.
